full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT or THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Oold Condominium II, EDSA cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City OFFICE OF SECRETARY D'LG OPINION NO. 40 August g, 2005 MR. REYNALDO J. DELA CRUZ 1850 M. Hizon Street, Sta. Cruz, Manila Dear Mr. Dela Cruz. This pertains to your letter requesting this Department to appoint you as Barangay Kagawad in view of the demise of one of the members of your sangguniang barangay. In reply thereto, may we invite your attention to Section 45(a)(3) of the Local Government Code of 1991 which provides for the proper procedure in filling up permanent vacancies in the Sanggunian. It states that: "Section 45(a)(3) Permanent vacancies in the Sanggunian where automatic successions provided above (Section 44) do not apply shall be filled by appointment in the following manner: xxx xxx xxx (3) The city or municipal mayor, in the case of sangguniang barangay, upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay concerned. Premises considered, it is clear in the above-cited provision that this Department has no authority to appoint you as barangay kagawad in your barangay. The appointing authority to fill up vacancies in the sanggunian barangay is the city/municipal mayor subject to the recommendation of the sanggunian barangay where the vacancy occurred. Hope we have enlightened you on the matter. cc:Dir. Rodolfo S. Feraren DILC-NCR Very truly yours, ANGE O T. EYES Secreta nf Atm LOCAL SILG05•007441
